entries.c3e5d24b9e9a541d: This reportable segment operates in the residential housing market, sells various tiles and related products and housing equipment, and also performs construction work; it is the larger of the 2 reportable segments by net sales. Net sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥77,963 million (up 4.4% year on year), and segment profit was ¥3,121 million (up 11.4%). The business is conducted by Aberuko Co., Ltd., Interugurō Co., Ltd., Imamura Co., Ltd., Arutisu Co., Ltd., Manikkusu Co., Ltd. and Maristo Co., Ltd. The securities report explains the breakdown of net sales in three parts: sales of tiles and building materials, tile and building material construction, and sales and construction of housing equipment.

The securities report cites as reasons for the increase in sales that, although demand for exterior wall tile work, which has high construction costs, was flat year on year, siding work increased owing to the acquisition of construction contractors and others, and sash work using subsidies from the window renovation program also increased.

entries.dc27f78a0e0e2279: According to the [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]], the company is a pure holding company that manages the business operations of its subsidiaries through management guidance and the leasing of real estate. Eight consolidated subsidiaries sell various tiles and related products and housing-related equipment, and carry out tile work, interior finishing work, stonework, plumbing work, air-conditioning work, sanitary equipment work and gas work. The [[term:segment|reportable segments]] are two: the Single-Family Housing Business and the Large-Scale Property Business. A characteristic of the company is that it combines, within the same group, a business that purchases and sells goods with a business that undertakes construction work. In procurement, LIXIL Corporation accounted for 38.4% of merchandise and materials purchases for the fiscal year ended September 2025, and the securities report states that if transactions with this company became impossible, it could affect performance.

entries.e86a7b5c70fd850d: Sales of tiles and building materials. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥16,518 million (up 1.1% year on year). The securities report gives as reasons that demand for high-priced original-brand tiles with strong design appeal decreased, while demand for tiles for distribution increased and the handling volume of interior materials such as living building materials also increased.
entries.e9064af7208da333: The sale of housing equipment such as water heaters, kitchens, vanities and sanitary ceramics, and air conditioning equipment, and the replacement and installation work for them. Net sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥43,456 million (up 4.7% from the same period of the previous year), the largest of the 3 categories in the Detached Housing Business. The securities report cites as reasons for the increase in sales: growing demand for replacing high-efficiency water heaters using subsidies from the energy-saving program, increased handling of kitchens, vanities and sanitary ceramics through the development of new customers, and growing demand for replacing air conditioning equipment due to the intense heat and heatstroke countermeasures.
